mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS avgScore, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_user_review WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND status = 1 AND rating IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) FROM tb_user_review WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND status = 1 AND rating IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT content FROM tb_user_review WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND status = 1 AND content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND CHAR_LENGTH(content) BETWEEN 5 AND 500 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 100
